title: Xanthe and the Ledger
author: Noor Coldharbour
blurb: Edmund Thackeray, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
